# Panorama decoder fixtures

These fixtures are synthetic solid-purple frames generated by FFmpeg's `color`
source for Batshit tests on 2026-09-08. They contain no artwork, personal media,
audio, downloaded content, or model output. Both are 256×128, YUV420, two frames
at 2 fps (one second), in MP4 with fast-start metadata.

AV1 and HEVC bytes are retained so a packaged decoder can be tested without
requiring it to include either encoder. The production `inspectGoonSceneVideo`
function must recover the codec and dimensions and produce a decodable 480×240
JPEG. This is a software upload-decoder regression check; it does not establish
8K performance or browser playback support.

Generated with FFmpeg 8.1.2 on arm64 macOS (SVT-AV1 4.2.0 for AV1, libx265
for HEVC) using these commands from this folder. SVT-AV1 maps preset 12 to 11
in this version; these tiny decoder fixtures are not visual-quality samples.

```sh
ffmpeg -nostdin -v error -f lavfi -i color=c=purple:s=256x128:r=2 -frames:v 2 -an -c:v libsvtav1 -threads 1 -preset 12 -crf 40 -pix_fmt yuv420p -map_metadata -1 -movflags +faststart av1-256x128.mp4
ffmpeg -nostdin -v error -f lavfi -i color=c=purple:s=256x128:r=2 -frames:v 2 -an -c:v libx265 -threads 1 -preset ultrafast -crf 40 -x265-params pools=1:frame-threads=1:info=0 -pix_fmt yuv420p -tag:v hvc1 -map_metadata -1 -movflags +faststart hevc-256x128.mp4
```

The content is deterministic; encoded bytes can vary with encoder versions.
Checksums in `SHA256SUMS` identify the retained files.

Run the suite from `batshit-server/server`:

```sh
node --test tests/goonSceneVideo.integration.cjs
```

To test packaged binaries, set `FFMPEG_PATH` and `FFPROBE_PATH` to their absolute
paths. Existing negative-validation tests generate H.264 fixtures with host
`ffmpeg`; `BATSHIT_TEST_FFMPEG_ENCODER_PATH` can choose a separate binary with
`libx264`. It deliberately does not inherit `FFMPEG_PATH`. Missing fixture or
decoder dependencies fail the suite instead of skipping codec coverage.
